question: In which sport did Mirabai Chanu win India's first Gold Medal at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weightlifting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu** won **India's first gold medal **at **the Commonwealth Games 2022** in the sport of **Weightlifting**.
 
• She won the gold medal in the women's 49 kg weightlifting category by lifting a total weight of 196 kg, which included 86 kg in snatch and 110 kg in clean and jerk.
 
• Mirabai Chanu had previously won a silver medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games and a gold medal at the 2017 World Weightlifting Championships.
 
• Weightlifting is a strength sport in which athletes compete by lifting weights in two different movements - snatch and clean and jerk. It requires a combination of strength, power, speed, and technique.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Boxing is a combat sport in which two people, usually wearing protective gloves, throw punches at each other for a predetermined amount of time in a boxing ring. India has won several medals in boxing at the Commonwealth Games, including gold medals in 2002, 2006, 2010, and 2018.
 
• Archery is a sport in which participants shoot arrows at a target from a certain distance. India has won several medals in archery at the Commonwealth Games, including gold medals in 2010 and 2018.
 
• Shooting is a sport in which participants use firearms or airguns to shoot at targets. India has been very successful in shooting at the Commonwealth Games, winning several gold, silver, and bronze medals over the years.
